work.scenario: You are in a team meeting discussing the need to improve internal systems and processes to stay competitive.

Transformasi digital penting untuk kekal relevan dalam pasaran kini.

life.scenario: You are at home, trying to stream a movie, but the internet is slow. You also need to buy groceries online and ask for help.
key_phrases: Aduh, line internet ni slow betul, tak ada signal ke?
Jom kita guna online platform untuk beli barang dapur.
Boleh tak tolong betulkan masalah Wi-Fi ni?

tech.scenario: You are an IT support personnel explaining a technical issue to a user and later discussing future technology trends with a colleague.
key_phrases: Saya akan cuba menyelesaikan masalah teknikal ini secepat mungkin.

Kecerdasan Buatan (AI) akan mengubah banyak industri dalam masa akan datang.
